nameEn: Manufacture of veneer sheets and wood-based panels
description: This class includes the manufacture of veneer sheets and wood-based panels such as plywood, particle board, oriented strand board and fibreboard.
includes: manufacture of plywood, blockboard, laminboard and battenboard
manufacture of particle board and oriented strand board
manufacture of fibre building board: hardboard, medium-density fibreboard (MDF)
excludes: sawmilling and planing of wood, see 1610
